source: ISO 286-1:2010, Tables 1 to 3; mm deviations from the nominal size
holds: holes and shafts c to u, grades IT4 to IT13, over 0 up to 500 mm

presets.name: Loose running
presets.use: Wide clearance for rough work or parts that get hot or dirty.

presets.name: Free running
presets.use: Large temperature swings, high speeds or heavy journal pressures.

presets.name: Close running
presets.use: Accurate running at moderate speed and journal pressure.

presets.name: Sliding
presets.use: Moves and turns freely and locates accurately: a guide pin, a slide.

presets.name: Locational clearance
presets.use: Snug, assembled by hand, located accurately: a spigot, a dowel hole.

presets.name: Locational transition
presets.use: Accurate location, a compromise between clearance and interference.

presets.name: Locational transition, tighter
presets.use: More accurate location where more interference is fine.

presets.name: Locational interference (press)
presets.use: Pressed in, rigid and accurate, taken apart with a press.

presets.name: Medium drive
presets.use: Pressed into steel or shrunk on: the tightest fit for cast iron.

presets.name: Force
presets.use: Shrunk on or pressed hard where the parts must carry load by friction.
